title: Material showcase

captions.frosted: Frosted glass: lit · frosted · fill · colour
captions.glass: Glass: lit · clear · fill · colour · lens off

captions.layer: Anatomy by layer: solid = base · dashed = overlay
captions.relief: Anatomy by relief: grey = ground · blue = raised · green = recessed
captions.face: Anatomy by face: grey = neutral · red = solid · pink = emissive · amber = display

commands: write the system's material tokens (named by relief, face and layer, under data-material) to {work}/materials.css and add it to tokens.css, or pass it with --style

acceptance: Every part carries data-layer (base, overlay), data-relief (ground, raised, recessed) and data-face (neutral, solid, emissive, display); marks carry none.

Overlays (menu, combobox list, tooltip, dialog, alert dialog, menu-bar menu) sit directly on the tile's grid paper, so frosted and clear transmission have something to show; no specimen draws its own backdrop.
States are attribute moves beside rest: pressed (raised → recessed), latched or selected (recessed; solid when latched or the primary choice), live (emissive).
Boxes are identical across materials and schemes: uiBentoCheck() compares every material in each scheme.
Paint comes only from the system's material tokens; this source adds the material axis and the anatomy overlay, nothing else.
